# Hardseal

Hardseal helps CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 teams find weak evidence before formal review.

## Primary Offer

Hardseal Evidence Integrity Review

Price: $5,500 one-time B2B review

URL: https://hardseal.ai/pilot.html

## Public Proof

AI-era evidence contamination engine:
https://github.com/ricojallen37-sketch/ai-detection

Current public release:
https://github.com/ricojallen37-sketch/ai-detection/releases/tag/v1.1.0

Proof points:

- MIT-licensed public repository
- Python standard library only
- No phone-home requirement
- 107-test suite
- GitHub Actions CI across Python 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12
- Commitment verification for the frozen v0.2 scoring bundle

## Who It Helps

- Defense contractors
- DIB suppliers
- MSPs supporting GovCon clients
- RPOs and CMMC consultants
- GovCon cybersecurity teams
- NIST SP 800-171 programs preparing evidence packages

## What It Reviews

- SSPs
- POA&Ms
- SPRS snapshots
- Policies
- Screenshots
- Tickets
- Exports
- Control evidence
- Compliance evidence packages

## What It Finds

- SSP-to-evidence contradictions
- Unsupported control claims
- POA&M and SPRS inconsistencies
- AI-generated or boilerplate artifact risk
- Missing proof
- Readiness gaps before formal review

## Important Boundary

Hardseal does not certify compliance.

Hardseal does not replace a C3PAO.

Hardseal does not make final assessment determinations.

Hardseal provides pre-assessment evidence integrity support.
